commands.command: git fetch --prune origin && test "$(git rev-parse origin/main)" = "771b23456cf7b3fafe62cba3263e1f8f7118580b"

ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIALS=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop link.localclimate.app; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 1; CIDR=$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell ip -4 addr show wlan0 | sed -n 's/.*inet \([0-9.]*/[0-9]*\).*/\1/p' | head -1 | tr -d ''); test -n "$CIDR"; echo "PHONE_CIDR=$CIDR"; RANGE=$(CIDR="$CIDR" python3 -c 'import ipaddress,os; i=ipaddress.ip_interface(os.environ["CIDR"]); n=i.network if i.network.num_addresses<=256 else ipaddress.ip_network(f"{i.ip}/24", strict=False); hosts=list(n.hosts()); print(str(hosts[0])+" "+str(hosts[-1]))'); START=$(printf '%s' "$RANGE" | awk '{print $1}'); END=$(printf '%s' "$RANGE" | awk '{print $2}'); echo "SCAN_RANGE=$START-$END"; printf '%s
' "$START" >/tmp/lcl_scan_start; printf '%s
' "$END" >/tmp/lcl_scan_end

ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1; exit}'); PID=$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward --remove tcp:9222 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" forward tcp:9222 localabstract:webview_devtools_remote_$PID >/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json >/dev/null

WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{if(!document.body.innerText.includes("What do you want to do?"))return document.body.innerText.slice(0,300);const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.includes("Control temperature"));if(!b)throw new Error("temperature button missing");b.click();return "opened temperature"})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails)process.exit(1);console.log(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1

WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const add=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==="Add plug");if(!add)throw new Error("Add plug missing");add.click();return true})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails)process.exit(1);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1; WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==="Scan network");if(!b)throw new Error("Scan network missing");b.click();return true})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails)process.exit(1);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1

START=$(cat /tmp/lcl_scan_start); END=$(cat /tmp/lcl_scan_end); WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); START="$START" END="$END" WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const xs=[...document.querySelectorAll("input")];if(xs.length<2)throw new Error("scan inputs missing");for(const [e,v] of [[xs[0],${JSON.stringify(process.env.START)}],[xs[1],${JSON.stringify(process.env.END)}]]){const s=Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,"value").set;s.call(e,v);e.dispatchEvent(new Event("input",{bubbles:true}));e.dispatchEvent(new Event("change",{bubbles:true}));}return xs.map(x=>x.value).join(" -> " )})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails){console.error(JSON.stringify(m.result.exceptionDetails));process.exit(1)}console.log("RANGE_INPUTS="+m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}' && sleep 1

WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"])'); WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`(()=>{const b=[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].find(x=>x.innerText.trim()==="Start scan"||x.innerText.trim()==="Scan");if(!b)throw new Error("scan start button missing: "+[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()).join(" | "));b.click();return b.innerText.trim()})()`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){if(m.result.exceptionDetails){console.error(JSON.stringify(m.result.exceptionDetails));process.exit(1)}console.log("SCAN_CLICK="+m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}'

for i in $(seq 1 45); do sleep 4; WS=$(curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:9222/json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d[0]["webSocketDebuggerUrl"] if d else "")'); test -n "$WS" || { echo 'WebView disappeared during scan' >&2; exit 1; }; OUT=$(WS="$WS" node -e 'const ws=new WebSocket(process.env.WS);ws.onopen=()=>ws.send(JSON.stringify({id:1,method:"Runtime.evaluate",params:{expression:`JSON.stringify({text:document.body.innerText,buttons:[...document.querySelectorAll("button")].map(x=>x.innerText.trim()).filter(Boolean)})`,returnByValue:true}}));ws.onmessage=e=>{const m=JSON.parse(e.data);if(m.id===1){process.stdout.write(m.result.result.value);ws.close();}}'); printf 'SCAN_POLL_%02d=%s\n' "$i" "$(printf '%s' "$OUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(" | ".join(d["text"].splitlines()[-12:]))')"; if printf '%s' "$OUT" | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); b=d["buttons"]; raise SystemExit(0 if any(x in ("Start scan","Scan") for x in b) and not any("Stop" in x for x in b) else 1)'; then printf '%s' "$OUT" >/tmp/lcl_scan_result.json; break; fi; done; test -s /tmp/lcl_scan_result.json; python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("/tmp/lcl_scan_result.json")); print("FINAL_SCAN_TEXT_BEGIN"); print(d["text"]); print("FINAL_SCAN_TEXT_END")'
